question: After the correctness and proof gaps are resolved, should OpenClaw accept a bundled xAI Grok realtime voice provider with provider-local config and an xAI runtime `ws` dependency?
rationale: The PR adds a new bundled provider capability and dependency graph surface, so correctness alone cannot decide product acceptance or dependency authorization.

options.title: Accept after blockers
options.body: Merge once provider-clear interruption is fixed, current-head live proof is supplied, and dependency/security approval is recorded for the exact head.

options.title: Externalize the provider
options.body: Ask for this to ship as an external plugin/ClawHub package if maintainers do not want another bundled realtime provider in core distribution.

options.title: Pause for provider API direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide whether xAI should also support provider-websocket/client-secret semantics or remain gateway-relay only.

recommendation.title: Accept after blockers
recommendation.body: Merge once provider-clear interruption is fixed, current-head live proof is supplied, and dependency/security approval is recorded for the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for bundled-provider acceptance and dependency/security approval coordination based on CODEOWNERS and adjacent history.
